author: mark
text:
v0.3 built-in tool: read_file

Ships the read_file tool per ARCH §3.3 / §12: a `lernie tool read_file`
subcommand that reads `tool_use.input` JSON from stdin and writes the
file's bytes to stdout (rejecting >1 MiB), backed by a new builtin
module dispatcher so subsequent tools (bash) slot in as match arms.

Adds:
- schemas/tools/read_file.json — input schema for the tools-list.
- skills/read_file/SKILL.md — when-to-use guidance for the model.
- tests/read_file_tool.rs — end-to-end through the tool executor
  against the cargo-built lernie binary, asserting both the success
  shape and is_error+stderr-concat on failure.

Refactors subprocess::spawn_and_capture to retry on ETXTBSY past a
200ms budget — closes the fork-exec write-fd race surfaced more
frequently by the new test count under parallel-test load.
